id: \bCrasher Wake: Hahaha! Let's go!
en: \bCrasher Wake: Hahaha! Let's go!
it: \bOmar: Ahahah! Andiamo!

id: \bCrasher Wake: Come back and try again whenever you want.
en: \bCrasher Wake: Come back and try again whenever you want.
it: \bOmar: Torna a riprovarci quando vuoi.

id: \bChuck: You think you're tough enough?
en: \bChuck: You think you're tough enough?
it: \bFurio: Credi di essere abbastanza tosto?

id: \bChuck: To lose to a kid. The next generation is doing great.
en: \bChuck: To lose to a kid. The next generation is doing great.
it: \bFurio: Perdere contro un ragazzino. La nuova generazione se la cava alla grande.

id: \rMalva: I heard you were at Lumiose City during Team Flare's attack. I myself used to be a member, but not anymore. I'm still strong though.
en: \rMalva: I heard you were at Lumiose City during Team Flare's attack. I myself used to be a member, but not anymore. I'm still strong though.
it: \rMalva: Ho sentito che eri a Luminopoli durante l'attacco del Team Flare. Anch'io ne facevo parte, ma ora non più. Sono comunque ancora forte.

id: \rMalva: It's no wonder Lysandre lost.
en: \rMalva: It's no wonder Lysandre lost.
it: \rMalva: Non c'è da stupirsi che Elisio abbia perso.

id: \rOlympia: Have anything new to show me?
en: \rOlympia: Have anything new to show me?
it: \rAstra: Hai qualcosa di nuovo da mostrarmi?

id: \rOlympia: There are still some surprises after all.
en: \rOlympia: There are still some surprises after all.
it: \rAstra: Dopotutto ci sono ancora delle sorprese.

id: \rLucy: Is luck on your side?
en: \rLucy: Is luck on your side?
it: \rLucy: La fortuna è dalla tua parte?

id: \rLucy: Maybe next time.
en: \rLucy: Maybe next time.
it: \rLucy: Sarà per la prossima volta.

id: \rOpal: Oh? Ready for another quiz?
en: \rOpal: Oh? Ready for another quiz?
it: \rPoppy: Oh? Pronto per un altro quiz?

id: \rOpal: I've grown tired. Leave.
en: \rOpal: I've grown tired. Leave.
it: \rPoppy: Mi sono stancata. Vattene.

id: \rDiantha: Why am I not suprised to see you here, \PN? I suppose I'm ready.
en: \rDiantha: Why am I not suprised to see you here, \PN? I suppose I'm ready.
it: \rDiantha: Perché non mi sorprende vederti qui, \PN? Suppongo di essere pronta.

id: \rDiantha: If I used a full team against you, I'd be unstoppable.
en: \rDiantha: If I used a full team against you, I'd be unstoppable.
it: \rDiantha: Se avessi usato una squadra completa contro di te, sarei stata inarrestabile.

id: \bRamos: Back for more I see.
en: \bRamos: Back for more I see.
it: \bAmur: Vedo che sei tornato per un'altra lezione.

id: \bRamos: You did good child.
en: \bRamos: You did good child.
it: \bAmur: Te la sei cavata bene, ragazzo.

id: \rJasmine: Let's take it nice and easy.
en: \rJasmine: Let's take it nice and easy.
it: \rJasmine: Prendiamocela con calma.

id: \rJasmine: That battle was fun. I'm so glad we did this.
en: \rJasmine: That battle was fun. I'm so glad we did this.
it: \rJasmine: È stata una lotta divertente. Sono così felice che l'abbiamo fatta.

id: \rOlivia: Back for more I see.
en: \rOlivia: Back for more I see.
it: \rOlivia: Vedo che sei tornato per un'altra lezione.

id: \rOlivia: I look forward to the next battle.
en: \rOlivia: I look forward to the next battle.
it: \rOlivia: Non vedo l'ora della prossima lotta.

id: \rSkyla: My Air Battle has already told me the outcome.
en: \rSkyla: My Air Battle has already told me the outcome.
it: \rAnemone: La mia Lotta Aerea mi ha già detto come andrà a finire.

id: \rSkyla: I guess I need to battle to figure out the real outcome.
en: \rSkyla: I guess I need to battle to figure out the real outcome.
it: \rAnemone: Credo di dover lottare per scoprire come andrà davvero.

id: \bCress: I'm about to serve up a mouth savoring meal.
en: \bCress: I'm about to serve up a mouth savoring meal.
it: \bMaisello: Sto per servirti un pasto da leccarsi i baffi.

id: \bCress: You served up a real beating.
en: \bCress: You served up a real beating.
it: \bMaisello: Mi hai servito una bella batosta.

id: \bBrawly: Time to ride the waves.
en: \bBrawly: Time to ride the waves.
it: \bRudi: È ora di cavalcare le onde.

id: \bBrawly: Come visit the island sometime. The waves are great there.
en: \bBrawly: Come visit the island sometime. The waves are great there.
it: \bRudi: Vieni a trovarmi sull'isola, prima o poi. Le onde lì sono fantastiche.

id: \bSiebold: Let me cook you up something tasteful.
en: \bSiebold: Let me cook you up something tasteful.
it: \bNarciso: Lascia che ti cucini qualcosa di gustoso.

id: \bSiebold: If I wasn't up to your tastes try one of the other members of the Kalos Elite Four.
en: \bSiebold: If I wasn't up to your tastes try one of the other members of the Kalos Elite Four.
it: \bNarciso: Se non ero di tuo gusto, prova con uno degli altri membri dei Superquattro di Kalos.

id: \bGiovanni: This time victory will be mine.
en: \bGiovanni: This time victory will be mine.
it: \bGiovanni: Stavolta la vittoria sarà mia.

id: \bGiovanni: Leave while you can.
en: \bGiovanni: Leave while you can.
it: \bGiovanni: Vattene finché puoi.

id: \bBrandon: You don't stand a chance.
en: \bBrandon: You don't stand a chance.
it: \bBrandon: Non hai alcuna possibilità.

id: \bBrandon: Continue to love and support your team.
en: \bBrandon: Continue to love and support your team.
it: \bBrandon: Continua ad amare e sostenere la tua squadra.

id: \rDrasna: Back for more?
en: \rDrasna: Back for more?
it: \rDrasna: Sei tornato per un'altra lezione?

id: \rDrasna: I suppose you won this time.
en: \rDrasna: I suppose you won this time.
it: \rDrasna: Suppongo che stavolta abbia vinto tu.

id: \bMarlon: Let's ride the waves.
en: \bMarlon: Let's ride the waves.
it: \bCiprian: Cavalchiamo le onde.

id: \bMarlon: That was a sick battle.
en: \bMarlon: That was a sick battle.
it: \bCiprian: È stata una lotta pazzesca.

id: \rCissy: I've trained hard. I think I can do this.
en: \rCissy: I've trained hard. I think I can do this.
it: \rCissy: Mi sono allenata duramente. Penso di potercela fare.

id: \rCissy: I'm going to get tougher.
en: \rCissy: I'm going to get tougher.
it: \rCissy: Diventerò più forte.

id: \bNanu:... So, you're back?
en: \bNanu:... So, you're back?
it: \bAugusto:... Allora, sei tornato?

id: \bNanu: Give me some time to rest.
en: \bNanu: Give me some time to rest.
it: \bAugusto: Dammi un po' di tempo per riposare.

id: \bBrock: Time for a battle, \PN.
en: \bBrock: Time for a battle, \PN.
it: \bBrock: È ora di lottare, \PN.

id: \bBrock: Good to see you again, \PN.
en: \bBrock: Good to see you again, \PN.
it: \bBrock: Che piacere rivederti, \PN.

id: \bWulfric: Think you can handle it?
en: \bWulfric: Think you can handle it?
it: \bEdel: Pensi di farcela?

id: \bWulfric: Your power is always at its peak.
en: \bWulfric: Your power is always at its peak.
it: \bEdel: Il tuo potere è sempre al massimo.

id: \bLance: We meet again. It's time I tested you in battle.
en: \bLance: We meet again. It's time I tested you in battle.
it: \bLance: Ci incontriamo di nuovo. È ora che ti metta alla prova in una lotta.

id: \bLance: I'm impressed. You're deserving of the Champion title.
en: \bLance: I'm impressed. You're deserving of the Champion title.
it: \bLance: Sono colpito. Meriti il titolo di Campione.

id: \bWikstrom: It is a pleasure to see you again. Let us fight with chivalry and honor.
en: \bWikstrom: It is a pleasure to see you again. Let us fight with chivalry and honor.
it: \bTimeos: È un piacere rivederti. Combattiamo con cavalleria e onore.

id: \bWikstrom: I enjoyed our fight. Continue to train yourself.
en: \bWikstrom: I enjoyed our fight. Continue to train yourself.
it: \bTimeos: Mi è piaciuto il nostro duello. Continua ad allenarti.

id: \bClay: You think you stand a chance?
en: \bClay: You think you stand a chance?
it: \bRafan: Pensi di avere qualche possibilità?

id: \bClay: It was all luck and you know it.
en: \bClay: It was all luck and you know it.
it: \bRafan: È stata tutta fortuna e lo sai.

id: \rAnabel: Does your connection beat mine?
en: \rAnabel: Does your connection beat mine?
it: \rAnabel: Il tuo legame supera il mio?

id: \rAnabel: Even my psychic powers were no match.
en: \rAnabel: Even my psychic powers were no match.
it: \rAnabel: Nemmeno i miei poteri psichici sono serviti.

id: \bLeon: Champion time!
en: \bLeon: Champion time!
it: \bDandel: È l'ora del Campione!

id: \bLeon: As strong as ever. The rush you give me is like no other.
en: \bLeon: As strong as ever. The rush you give me is like no other.
it: \bDandel: Forte come sempre. L'adrenalina che mi dai non ha eguali.

id: \bLt. Surge: So the punk is back.
en: \bLt. Surge: So the punk is back.
it: \bLt. Surge: Così il teppista è tornato.

id: \bLt. Surge: So you beat me again. It won't happen again.
en: \bLt. Surge: So you beat me again. It won't happen again.
it: \bLt. Surge: Quindi mi hai battuto di nuovo. Non succederà più.

id: \rMaylene: Full power!
en: \rMaylene: Full power!
it: \rMarzia: Massima potenza!

id: \rMaylene: I just need to work harder.
en: \rMaylene: I just need to work harder.
it: \rMarzia: Devo solo impegnarmi di più.

id: \rRoxie: Let's turn it up to eleven.
en: \rRoxie: Let's turn it up to eleven.
it: \rVelia: Alziamo il volume al massimo.

id: \rRoxie: That battle spoke to my soul.
en: \rRoxie: That battle spoke to my soul.
it: \rVelia: Questa lotta mi ha parlato all'anima.

id: \bDanny: Good to see you again.
en: \bDanny: Good to see you again.
it: \bDanny: Che piacere rivederti.

id: \bDanny: Don't worry about it. I'll get better.
en: \bDanny: Don't worry about it. I'll get better.
it: \bDanny: Non preoccuparti. Migliorerò.

id: \rHapu: Maybe this time I can give you a good fight.
en: \rHapu: Maybe this time I can give you a good fight.
it: \rHapu: Forse stavolta riuscirò a darti del filo da torcere.

id: \rHapu: Come back soon.
en: \rHapu: Come back soon.
it: \rHapu: Torna presto.

id: \bRoark: Let's bring the power.
en: \bRoark: Let's bring the power.
it: \bPedro: Tiriamo fuori tutta la potenza.

id: \bRoark: That battle was intense. Can't wait for next time.
en: \bRoark: That battle was intense. Can't wait for next time.
it: \bPedro: Che lotta intensa. Non vedo l'ora della prossima volta.

id: \bBrycen: Let's set the stage.
en: \bBrycen: Let's set the stage.
it: \bSilvestro: Prepariamo la scena.

id: \bBrycen: This is very different from the stage.
en: \bBrycen: This is very different from the stage.
it: \bSilvestro: È molto diverso dal palcoscenico.

id: \bAlder:... Oh, is it time to fight?
en: \bAlder:... Oh, is it time to fight?
it: \bNardo:... Oh, è ora di lottare?

id: \bAlder:...
en: \bAlder:...
it: \bNardo:...

id: \bBlaine: Back for more are you?
en: \bBlaine: Back for more are you?
it: \bBlaine: Sei tornato per un'altra lezione, eh?

id: \bBlaine: Not even the best tricks can get me out of that one.
en: \bBlaine: Not even the best tricks can get me out of that one.
it: \bBlaine: Nemmeno i trucchi migliori possono tirarmi fuori da questa.

id: \bSpenser: Let us begin.
en: \bSpenser: Let us begin.
it: \bSpenser: Cominciamo.

id: \bSpenser: Don't get frustrated. Let your partners guide you.
en: \bSpenser: Don't get frustrated. Let your partners guide you.
it: \bSpenser: Non scoraggiarti. Lascia che i tuoi compagni ti guidino.

id: \bWattson: Wahahaha. About time we do this.
en: \bWattson: Wahahaha. About time we do this.
it: \bWalter: Uahahah. Era ora che lo facessimo.

id: \bWattson: Wahaha. I just can't win.
en: \bWattson: Wahaha. I just can't win.
it: \bWalter: Uahah. Proprio non riesco a vincere.

id: \rWhitney: Don't make me get serious.
en: \rWhitney: Don't make me get serious.
it: \rChiara: Non costringermi a fare sul serio.

id: \rWhitney: Don't think that this is over.
en: \rWhitney: Don't think that this is over.
it: \rChiara: Non pensare che sia finita qui.

id: \bSteven: Well \PN, let's test each other out.
en: \bSteven: Well \PN, let's test each other out.
it: \bRocco: Bene, \PN, mettiamoci alla prova a vicenda.

id: \bSteven: Please return soon.
en: \bSteven: Please return soon.
it: \bRocco: Torna presto, per favore.

id: It's your spot. Don't you feel proud?
en: It's your spot. Don't you feel proud?
it: È il tuo posto. Non ti senti orgoglioso?

id: \rRoxanne: See if you can teach me anything.
en: \rRoxanne: See if you can teach me anything.
it: \rPetra: Vediamo se riesci a insegnarmi qualcosa.

id: \rRoxanne: Stop by and visit the school anytime you can.
en: \rRoxanne: Stop by and visit the school anytime you can.
it: \rPetra: Passa a visitare la scuola ogni volta che puoi.

id: \rCandice: What are we waiting for? Let's get started!
en: \rCandice: What are we waiting for? Let's get started!
it: \rBianca: Cosa stiamo aspettando? Cominciamo!

id: \rCandice: I guess I battled a little too seriously.
en: \rCandice: I guess I battled a little too seriously.
it: \rBianca: Forse ho lottato in modo un po' troppo serio.

id: \bDrake: I'm ready whenever you are. I'll represent the entire Hoenn Elite Four in their absence.
en: \bDrake: I'm ready whenever you are. I'll represent the entire Hoenn Elite Four in their absence.
it: \bDrake: Sono pronto quando vuoi. Rappresenterò l'intero gruppo dei Superquattro di Hoenn in loro assenza.

id: \bDrake: Don't think my age has slowed me down.
en: \bDrake: Don't think my age has slowed me down.
it: \bDrake: Non pensare che l'età mi abbia rallentato.

id: \bKoga: Strike swiftly.
en: \bKoga: Strike swiftly.
it: \bKoga: Colpisci rapido.

id: \bKoga: Victory goes to the swift.
en: \bKoga: Victory goes to the swift.
it: \bKoga: La vittoria va ai più rapidi.

id: \bDrake: Let's see what two champions can do.
en: \bDrake: Let's see what two champions can do.
it: \bDrake: Vediamo cosa sanno fare due campioni.

id: \bDanny: It's always good to find a good challenger.
en: \bDanny: It's always good to find a good challenger.
it: \bDanny: Fa sempre piacere trovare uno sfidante valido.

id: \bChili: I'm gonna serve up a scorching meal.
en: \bChili: I'm gonna serve up a scorching meal.
it: \bChicco: Sto per servirti un piatto rovente.

id: \bChili: You served up a real beating.
en: \bChili: You served up a real beating.
it: \bChicco: Mi hai servito una bella batosta.

id: \rNurse Joy: You should take a break.
en: \rNurse Joy: You should take a break.
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Dovresti prenderti una pausa.

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \bVolkner: Good to see you again. Let's make this exciting.
en: \bVolkner: Good to see you again. Let's make this exciting.
it: \bCorrado: Che bello rivederti. Rendiamola emozionante.

id: \bVolkner: That was a rush. Come back any time.
en: \bVolkner: That was a rush. Come back any time.
it: \bCorrado: Che scarica di adrenalina. Torna quando vuoi.

id: \bNorman: Welcome. I hope you're ready.
en: \bNorman: Welcome. I hope you're ready.
it: \bNorman: Benvenuto. Spero tu sia pronto.

id: \bNorman: You did a great job.
en: \bNorman: You did a great job.
it: \bNorman: Hai fatto un ottimo lavoro.

id: \bWallace: I may love contests, but I can battle just as well as anyone else.
en: \bWallace: I may love contests, but I can battle just as well as anyone else.
it: \bAdriano: Amerò anche le gare, ma so lottare bene quanto chiunque altro.

id: \bWallace: We should do a performance together.
en: \bWallace: We should do a performance together.
it: \bAdriano: Dovremmo fare un'esibizione insieme.

id: \bGrant: Time to climb to the top.
en: \bGrant: Time to climb to the top.
it: \bLino: È ora di scalare fino in cima.

id: \bGrant: You've climbed high up in this world.
en: \bGrant: You've climbed high up in this world.
it: \bLino: Sei salito davvero in alto in questo mondo.

id: \bPryce: Don't hold back now.
en: \bPryce: Don't hold back now.
it: \bAlfredo: Non trattenerti proprio adesso.

id: \bPryce: It's rare to find a Trainer as good as you.
en: \bPryce: It's rare to find a Trainer as good as you.
it: \bAlfredo: È raro trovare un Allenatore bravo come te.

id: \rBertha: I figured I'd see you again.
en: \rBertha: I figured I'd see you again.
it: \rTerrie: Me lo sentivo che ti avrei rivisto.

id: \rBertha: You won't catch me off guard next time.
en: \rBertha: You won't catch me off guard next time.
it: \rTerrie: La prossima volta non mi coglierai impreparata.

id: \bDrayden: You hold a lot of potential. Let me see if I can help you grow.
en: \bDrayden: You hold a lot of potential. Let me see if I can help you grow.
it: \bAristide: Hai molto potenziale. Vediamo se posso aiutarti a crescere.

id: \bDrayden: You've gotten better.
en: \bDrayden: You've gotten better.
it: \bAristide: Sei migliorato.

id: \bRudy: Don't think I'm holding back.
en: \bRudy: Don't think I'm holding back.
it: \bRudy: Non pensare che mi tratterrò.

id: \bRudy: Come back when you're even better.
en: \bRudy: Come back when you're even better.
it: \bRudy: Torna quando sarai ancora più forte.

id: \rIris: Hi \PN! Back to battle a Champion?
en: \rIris: Hi \PN! Back to battle a Champion?
it: \rIris: Ciao \PN! Sei tornato a sfidare una Campionessa?

id: \rIris: I think we're both improving. Try to bring more Dragon types next time.
en: \rIris: I think we're both improving. Try to bring more Dragon types next time.
it: \rIris: Credo che stiamo migliorando tutti e due. La prossima volta prova a portare più tipi Drago.

id: \rElesa: Let's make this beautiful.
en: \rElesa: Let's make this beautiful.
it: \rCamelia: Rendiamola uno spettacolo meraviglioso.

id: \rElesa: Come back any time to show me a stunning battle.
en: \rElesa: Come back any time to show me a stunning battle.
it: \rCamelia: Torna quando vuoi a mostrarmi una lotta sfolgorante.

id: \rLenora: I guess I can give it a try.
en: \rLenora: I guess I can give it a try.
it: \rAloe: Beh, posso fare un tentativo.

id: \rLenora: Impressive. Keep training like that and become a champion one day.
en: \rLenora: Impressive. Keep training like that and become a champion one day.
it: \rAloe: Notevole. Continua ad allenarti così e un giorno diventerai campione.

id: \rCynthia: At long last I get to try you on myself. Are you ready \PN?
en: \rCynthia: At long last I get to try you on myself. Are you ready \PN?
it: \rCamilla: Finalmente posso metterti alla prova di persona. Sei pronto, \PN?

id: \rCynthia: Keep traveling and discovering new things. It will help you out in the long run.
en: \rCynthia: Keep traveling and discovering new things.  It will help you out in the long run.
it: \rCamilla: Continua a viaggiare e a scoprire cose nuove.  Alla lunga ti sarà d'aiuto.

id: \rFlannery: I'm ready... I mean I'm going to... Whatever. Let's just fight.
en: \rFlannery: I'm ready... I mean I'm going to... Whatever.  Let's just fight.
it: \rFiammetta: Sono pronta... cioè, sto per... Lasciamo perdere.  Lottiamo e basta.

id: \rFlannery: I just need some more practice.
en: \rFlannery: I just need some more practice.
it: \rFiammetta: Mi serve solo un po' più di pratica.

id: \rBea: Trainer of Pikachu. I've trained hard for this rematch.
en: \rBea: Trainer of Pikachu. I've trained hard for this rematch.
it: \rFabia: Allenatore di Pikachu. Mi sono allenata duramente per questa rivincita.

id: \rBea: I will continue to train.
en: \rBea: I will continue to train.
it: \rFabia: Continuerò ad allenarmi.

id: \rClair: Welcome. Think you are still strong enough to beat me?
en: \rClair: Welcome. Think you are still strong enough to beat me?
it: \rSandra: Benvenuto. Pensi di essere ancora abbastanza forte da battermi?

id: \rClair: It's amazing how you keep getting stronger and stronger.
en: \rClair: It's amazing how you keep getting stronger and stronger.
it: \rSandra: È incredibile come tu diventi sempre più forte.

id: \bBugsy: I've done some research. I think I've got this one.
en: \bBugsy: I've done some research. I think I've got this one.
it: \bRaffaello: Ho fatto qualche ricerca. Stavolta credo di avercela in pugno.

id: \bBugsy: It's okay. I'll just study harder.
en: \bBugsy: It's okay. I'll just study harder.
it: \bRaffaello: Non fa niente. Studierò di più.

id: \bFlint: I'm ready for a good time.
en: \bFlint: I'm ready for a good time.
it: \bVulcano: Sono pronto a divertirmi.

id: \bFlint: I wish we could battle with more options. You give me a real challenge.
en: \bFlint: I wish we could battle with more options. You give me a real challenge.
it: \bVulcano: Vorrei che potessimo lottare con più opzioni. Sei davvero una bella sfida.

id: \rLuana: Have you improved?
en: \rLuana: Have you improved?
it: \rLuana: Sei migliorato?

id: \rLuana: There are still some surprises after all.
en: \rLuana: There are still some surprises after all.
it: \rLuana: Dopotutto, qualche sorpresa c'è ancora.

id: \bClemont: I'm ready, \PN.
en: \bClemont: I'm ready, \PN.
it: \bLem: Sono pronto, \PN.

id: \bClemont: You did great, \PN. I'll do even better next time.
en: \bClemont: You did great, \PN. I'll do even better next time.
it: \bLem: Sei stato bravissimo, \PN. La prossima volta farò ancora meglio.

id: \bCheren: Now that I'm ready let me show you my true power.
en: \bCheren: Now that I'm ready let me show you my true power.
it: \bCheren: Ora che sono pronto, lascia che ti mostri il mio vero potere.

id: \bCheren: There's nothing I can teach you.
en: \bCheren: There's nothing I can teach you.
it: \bCheren: Non c'è niente che io possa insegnarti.

id: \bAllister: R-Ready.
en: \bAllister: R-Ready.
it: \bOnion: P-Pronto.

id: \bAllister: U-Until next time.
en: \bAllister: U-Until next time.
it: \bOnion: A-Alla prossima.

id: \rViola: I'll take a picture after I win.
en: \rViola: I'll take a picture after I win.
it: \rVioletta: Scatterò una foto dopo aver vinto.

id: \rViola: Let me take a picture to celebrate your victory.
en: \rViola: Let me take a picture to celebrate your victory.
it: \rVioletta: Lascia che scatti una foto per festeggiare la tua vittoria.

id: \rValerie: Victory to the elegant.
en: \rValerie: Victory to the elegant.
it: \rValérie: La vittoria va a chi ha eleganza.

id: \rValerie: That battle was very elegant. I congratulate you.
en: \rValerie: That battle was very elegant. I congratulate you.
it: \rValérie: Quella lotta è stata molto elegante. Mi congratulo con te.

id: \rSabrina: I knew you would come.
en: \rSabrina: I knew you would come.
it: \rSabrina: Sapevo che saresti venuto.

id: \rSabrina: I wonder what I should do now?
en: \rSabrina: I wonder what I should do now?
it: \rSabrina: Chissà cosa dovrei fare adesso?

id: \bNoland: You'll never know what to expect with me.
en: \bNoland: You'll never know what to expect with me.
it: \bNoland: Con me non saprai mai cosa aspettarti.

id: \bNoland: It's okay. I'll just study harder.
en: \bNoland: It's okay. I'll just study harder.
it: \bNoland: Non fa niente. Studierò di più.

id: \bAaron: The power of my team will destroy you.
en: \bAaron: The power of my team will destroy you.
it: \bAaron: La potenza della mia squadra ti distruggerà.

id: \bAaron: Rematch anytime.
en: \bAaron: Rematch anytime.
it: \bAaron: Rivincita quando vuoi.

id: \rErika: Time for another battle.
en: \rErika: Time for another battle.
it: \rErika: È l'ora di un'altra lotta.

id: \rErika: That was pretty good.
en: \rErika: That was pretty good.
it: \rErika: Niente male davvero.

id: \rLorelei: I think you deserve a second chance. Prepare to be frozen in fear.
en: \rLorelei: I think you deserve a second chance.  Prepare to be frozen in fear.
it: \rLorelei: Credo che tu meriti una seconda possibilità.  Preparati a raggelare dalla paura.

id: \rLorelei: I look forward to your next challenge.
en: \rLorelei: I look forward to your next challenge.
it: \rLorelei: Attendo con ansia la tua prossima sfida.

id: \bMorty: Show me the power you possess.
en: \bMorty: Show me the power you possess.
it: \bAngelo: Mostrami il potere che possiedi.

id: \bMorty: What do I need to do to win?
en: \bMorty: What do I need to do to win?
it: \bAngelo: Cosa devo fare per vincere?

id: \bRaihan: I'll crush you.
en: \bRaihan: I'll crush you.
it: \bRaihan: Ti stritolerò.

id: \bRaihan: Not good enough for Leon yet.
en: \bRaihan: Not good enough for Leon yet.
it: \bRaihan: Non sono ancora abbastanza forte per Dandel.

id: \bBurgh: Time for a magnificent show.
en: \bBurgh: Time for a magnificent show.
it: \bArtemisio: È l'ora di uno spettacolo magnifico.

id: \bBurgh: That battle was amazing. I look forward to the next one.
en: \bBurgh: That battle was amazing. I look forward to the next one.
it: \bArtemisio: Che lotta stupenda. Non vedo l'ora della prossima.

id: \rMisty: I'm not going easy on you.
en: \rMisty: I'm not going easy on you.
it: \rMisty: Non ci andrò leggera con te.

id: \rMisty: How do I keep losing to you, \PN?
en: \rMisty: How do I keep losing to you, \PN?
it: \rMisty: Come faccio a perdere sempre contro di te, \PN?

id: \rGreta: Let's give it a fighting chance!
en: \rGreta: Let's give it a fighting chance!
it: \rGreta: Diamoci dentro e giochiamoci le nostre carte!

id: \rGreta: We went out with a bang.
en: \rGreta: We went out with a bang.
it: \rGreta: Siamo usciti di scena col botto.

id: \bTate: Do you think... \rLiza: You can beat us?
en: \bTate: Do you think... \rLiza: You can beat us?
it: \bTell: Pensi davvero... \rPat: Di poterci battere?

id: \bTate: I can't believe... \rLiza: You beat us.
en: \bTate: I can't believe... \rLiza: You beat us.
it: \bTell: Non posso credere... \rPat: Che tu ci abbia battuti.

id: \bLucian: It's very nice to meet you. Shall we get started?
en: \bLucian: It's very nice to meet you. Shall we get started?
it: \bLuciano: È un vero piacere conoscerti. Vogliamo cominciare?

id: \bLucian: Not every Elite Four member shows up for this. At the very least we have all of the Sinnoh members here.
en: \bLucian: Not every Elite Four member shows up for this. At the very least we have all of the Sinnoh members here.
it: \bLuciano: Non tutti i membri dei Superquattro si presentano qui. Se non altro, ci sono tutti quelli di Sinnoh.

id: \rFantina: Bonjour. Let us begin.
en: \rFantina: Bonjour. Let us begin.
it: \rFannie: Bonjour. Cominciamo pure.

id: \rFantina: Amazing! Just amazing!
en: \rFantina: Amazing! Just amazing!
it: \rFannie: Fantastico! Semplicemente fantastico!

id: \rGardenia: I hope you're prepared.
en: \rGardenia: I hope you're prepared.
it: \rGardenia: Spero che tu sia preparato.

id: \rGardenia: What did you think of the Cacnea I use? I'm training it for someone.
en: \rGardenia: What did you think of the Cacnea I use?  I'm training it for someone.
it: \rGardenia: Che ne pensi del Cacnea che uso?  Lo sto allenando per una persona.

id: \bFalkner: Time to soar.
en: \bFalkner: Time to soar.
it: \bValerio: È ora di spiccare il volo.

id: \bFalkner: You continue to impress me.
en: \bFalkner: You continue to impress me.
it: \bValerio: Continui a stupirmi.

id: \rAgatha: Good to see you again child. I won't go easy on you.
en: \rAgatha: Good to see you again child. I won't go easy on you.
it: \rAgatha: Che piacere rivederti, ragazzino. Non ci andrò piano con te.

id: \rAgatha: You did well. Challenge someone else, all of the Kanto Elite Four is here.
en: \rAgatha: You did well. Challenge someone else, all of the Kanto Elite Four is here.
it: \rAgatha: Te la sei cavata bene. Sfida qualcun altro, ci sono tutti i Superquattro di Kanto.

id: \bPiers: A battle? I suppose.
en: \bPiers: A battle? I suppose.
it: \bGinepro: Una lotta? Se proprio dobbiamo.

id: \bPiers: You did well.
en: \bPiers: You did well.
it: \bGinepro: Te la sei cavata bene.

id: \rKorrina: I'm gonna wipe the floor with you.
en: \rKorrina: I'm gonna wipe the floor with you.
it: \rOrnella: Ti farò mangiare la polvere.

id: \rKorrina: Lucario and I will win next time.
en: \rKorrina: Lucario and I will win next time.
it: \rOrnella: La prossima volta io e Lucario vinceremo.

id: \bJuan: Prepare, for it is time to face me!
en: \bJuan: Prepare, for it is time to face me!
it: \bRodolfo: Preparati, perché è giunto il momento di affrontarmi!

id: \bJuan: A spectacular battle!
en: \bJuan: A spectacular battle!
it: \bRodolfo: Una lotta spettacolare!

id: \bTucker: We may not have a crowd but we will still put on a show.
en: \bTucker: We may not have a crowd but we will still put on a show.
it: \bTucker: Non avremo un pubblico, ma daremo comunque spettacolo.

id: \bTucker: Until next time.
en: \bTucker: Until next time.
it: \bTucker: Alla prossima.

id: \rCaitlin: I don't believe we have met. My name is Caitlin, a member of the Unova Elite Four. Are you ready?
en: \rCaitlin: I don't believe we have met. My name is Caitlin, a member of the Unova Elite Four. Are you ready?
it: \rCatlina: Non credo che ci siamo già conosciuti. Mi chiamo Catlina e faccio parte dei Superquattro di Unima. Sei pronto?

id: \rCaitlin: That looked well rehearsed.
en: \rCaitlin: That looked well rehearsed.
it: \rCatlina: Sembrava una lotta ben provata.

id: \bHala: Time for another test.
en: \bHala: Time for another test.
it: \bHala: È ora di un'altra prova.

id: \bHala: Come back anytime.
en: \bHala: Come back anytime.
it: \bHala: Torna quando vuoi.

id: \bByron: Think you can beat my defense?
en: \bByron: Think you can beat my defense?
it: \bFerruccio: Pensi di poter superare la mia difesa?

id: \bByron: You might be good enough to beat my son.
en: \bByron: You might be good enough to beat my son.
it: \bFerruccio: Forse sei abbastanza forte da battere mio figlio.

id: \bCilan: \PN, allow me to serve you a variety of spices for today's course.
en: \bCilan: \PN, allow me to serve you a variety of spices for today's course.
it: \bSpighetto: \PN, permettimi di servirti un assortimento di spezie per la portata di oggi.

id: \bCilan: You served up a real beating, \PN.
en: \bCilan: You served up a real beating, \PN.
it: \bSpighetto: Mi hai servito una bella batosta, \PN.

id: \rWinona: Are you ready?
en: \rWinona: Are you ready?
it: \rAlice: Sei pronto?

id: \rWinona: Excellent job. You show mastery of the air.
en: \rWinona: Excellent job. You show mastery of the air.
it: \rAlice: Ottimo lavoro. Dimostri una vera padronanza del cielo.

id: \bBruno: I've been waiting for your arrival.
en: \bBruno: I've been waiting for your arrival.
it: \bBruno: Stavo aspettando il tuo arrivo.

id: \bBruno: Come back after I've trained more.
en: \bBruno: Come back after I've trained more.
it: \bBruno: Torna quando mi sarò allenato di più.
